verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no retention policy or deletion feature. The only related evidence is indirect: hybrid deployment keeps the scanner, S3 storage and AI inference inside the customer's AWS account, and an on-prem/self-hosted tier exists, so customers would control the stored code artifacts in their own infrastructure. Gecko still hosts the dashboard and database in hybrid mode. Missing for 10: documented retention periods, user-initiated deletion of scans/findings/uploaded code, account/data deletion workflow, retention controls for Gecko-hosted database data, independent corroboration.
